Name: securityMember
Description: Security member in the ivy security system. Beside ``ISecurityMember``, the component also accepts ``SecurityMemberDTO``, ``UserDTO`` and ``RoleDTO``.

Name: isShowAvatar
Description:
| Boolean value to specify avatar showing. Set to true to show avatar.
| The setting will detect Portal setting Portal.ShowAvatar as its default value, refer to HowTo: Update :ref:`update-portal-settings` for more details.
| If the Portal setting is not available, defaults to true.

Name: showLabel
Description: If false, the avatar is rendered without a label, neither the initials of the security member nor ``representName``.

Name: representName
Description: Text displayed in the avatar instead of the initials of the security member. The avatar is rendered as long as either ``securityMember`` or ``representName`` is set.

Name: displayName
Description: The security member name is displayed.

Name: displayNameRendered
Description: If false, the security member name is hidden.

Name: displayNameStyleClass
Description: The style class is applied for display name element.

Name: containerStyleClass
Description: The style class is applied for container element.

Name: isStandAlone
Description: Set to false when you use this component in :ref:`components-portal-components-user-selection` and :ref:`components-portal-components-role-selection`.

Name: isShowTechnicalDisplayNameOnTooltip
Description:
| Boolean value to specify showing the technical name of a security member on tooltips. Set to true to show the technical name.
| The setting will detect Portal setting Portal.ShowTooltipTechnicalName as its default value, refer to HowTo: Update :ref:`update-portal-settings` for more details.
| If the Portal setting is not available, defaults to false.
